unitAI-yhb99.description:
Observed during KAN-91 epic (Phase 3 unitAI-gp7nq.4 + chore unitAI-hyugm closing). The bd auto-close hook treats any seconder/reviewer completion event as a close signal regardless of the verdict (FAIL or PASS). Repro pattern: dispatch seconder → seconder FAILs → bd auto-closes parent bead anyway. Recovery: bd update <id> --status=in_progress to reopen. Observed twice in one session (Phase 3 bead auto-closed by hook after seconder 8d026b FAIL; pattern repeated on unitAI-hyugm after executor ced45d completion).

## SCOPE
Hook source likely in .xtrm/hooks/ or .beads/hooks/ — investigate where seconder/reviewer 'completion' events trigger bd close. Probably keying off run_complete event regardless of output verdict.

## SUCCESS
Auto-close gates on extracted verdict=PASS (or equivalent overall_verdict from seconder); FAIL/PARTIAL/BLOCKED leave the bead in_progress.

## CONSTRAINTS
- Hook should fail-open on verdict extraction failure (don't trap close on bad output).
- Reviewer auto-close should already be gated; this bug is about seconder/auxiliary specialists.
- Don't break the PASS happy path.
unitAI-yhb99.title: bd auto-close hook fires on FAILED seconder/reviewer completion (no verdict gate)
